contract: Pure mark for content that must not give orders: a checked version-1 neutral map with ordered distinct sources, trust class untrusted or derived, a byte bound and UTF-8 content; decode, encode, concat and wrap keep the least trusted class, and render gives the one content-tagged block for a model request. Marking grants no authority and prevents no injection.
limits: No claim that marking prevents prompt injection; that a model treats a marked block as data is an assumption, not a result of this Piece.
No check of who made the content, no authentication of a source and no detection of instructions inside content; the host stamps sources and trust truthfully.
The checked value is not a security boundary against BEAM code that forges it; a caller that copies content out of the value loses the mark.
The block format holds only while no content holds the first 128 bits of its own SHA-256 tag on a closing line.

grounding.claim: The production class decision least_trusted gives Derived when either operand is Derived, over the closed set of two classes; excludes the map check, rendering and what a caller marks.
Pinned Cure checks types and totality of the two-class decision; the source audit finds no axioms, holes, unresolved, unaudited, opaque or unproved-total definitions.

Named groups mark_survives, unmarked_refused, render_format and nested_least_trusted, plus the law and checked example; a left-operand class decision and a constant render tag are negative controls. Finite scenarios, not a proof of the map check or the format.
OTP :crypto SHA-256 of the content bytes gives the block tag.
Pinned Jason encodes and decodes the neutral map unchanged; only the test uses it.
Pinned Cure compilation, reduction checking and BEAM decision semantics; compiler soundness not locally proved.

The host or pattern stamps sources and trust truthfully, marks each tool result, retrieved document and member message before a prompt builder sees it, keeps the neutral map whole, and decides from the registry snapshot which text is a pinned skill instruction and so not content.

telemetry.contract: Pure functions emit no observations; the host owns instrumentation.

config.contract: The size bound is a recorded field of each marked value, not a setting; no ambient or hot configuration.

control.contract: No process or lifecycle to control.
